content: सञ्ज् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (सजति, सक्त; the स् of the root being changed to ष् after a preposition ending in इ or उ) .²1 To stick or adhere to, cling to; तुल्यगन्धिषु मत्तेभकटेषु फलरेणवः (ससञ्जुः) <ls>R. 4. 47</ls>. .²2 To go, move. .²3 To fasten. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} (सज्यते) .²1 To be attached to, cling or adhere to. .²2 To linger, hesitate.
